root_cause.text: The `mailbox-test` driver fails to check if the RX and TX channels are aliased to the same mailbox channel before freeing them during probe error cleanup or driver removal, resulting in a double-free of the channel.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that in both `mbox_test_probe` and `mbox_test_remove`, the condition for freeing the RX channel is updated from `if (tdev->rx_channel)` to `if (tdev->rx_channel && tdev->rx_channel != tdev->tx_channel)` to prevent calling `mbox_free_channel` on the same channel pointer twice.

mailbox: mailbox-test: free channels on probe error

On probe error, free the previously obtained channels. This not onl
bic_trace_step.code_snippet:
commit c02053a9055d5fdfd32432287cca8958db1d5bc5
Author: Wolfram Sang <wsa+renesas@sang-engineering.com>
Date:   Fri Apr 10 14:53:00 2026 +0200

    mailbox: mailbox-test: free channels on probe error
    
    On probe error, free the previously obtained channels. This not only
    prevents a leak, but also UAF scenarios because the client structure
    will be removed nonetheless because it was allocated with devm.
    
    Link: https://sashiko.dev/#/patchset/20260327151217.5327-2-wsa%2Brenesas
bic_trace_step.reason:
The commit introduces the 'err_free_chans' error path in 'mbox_test_probe' which frees both 'tx_channel' and 'rx_channel' using 'mbox_free_channel' without checking if they are aliased to the same channel: 

+err_free_chans:
+	if (tdev->tx_channel)
+		mbox_free_channel(tdev->tx_channel);
+	if (tdev->rx_channel)
+		mbox_free_channel(tdev->rx_channel);

If 'tx_channel' and 'rx_channel' are the same, this results in a double-free of the mailbox channel.
